taxonomy_name: Golana Million-Scale Product Type & Variant Framework
purpose: Represent millions or billions of product configurations without storing every possible combination as a separate record.
important_design_note: This file defines product type templates and attribute dimensions. It does not claim that every mathematical combination is a real product. Real buyable products must be verified against retailer/catalog data.

scalable_model.taxonomy: Category tree describing what an item is
scalable_model.product_type_templates: Leaf category templates describing relevant attributes
scalable_model.attribute_values: Open vocabularies or controlled value lists for each attribute
scalable_model.variant_generation: Generate candidate combinations on demand, not as a giant static JSON array
scalable_model.catalog_products: Actual retailer SKUs/listings with price, availability, seller, URL, and identifiers
scalable_model.many_to_many_categories: A product can be assigned to multiple categories when appropriate

combination_example.warning: Theoretical combinations are not guaranteed to exist or be sellable.

combination_rules: Do not enumerate all possible combinations in the taxonomy file.
Generate variants only when a user query, retailer feed, or product record requires them.
Apply category-specific constraints (for example, incompatible sizes, voltage, vehicle fitment, or product options).
Normalize attribute names and units before matching.
Use product identifiers such as GTIN, UPC, EAN, ISBN, MPN, and retailer SKU when available.
Keep actual product listings separate from inferred product types and theoretical variants.
Never create fake prices, stock status, retailer URLs, or product availability.
Support synonyms, spelling variants, multilingual names, and alternate category paths in separate search dictionaries.

recommended_database_entities.name: product_variants
recommended_database_entities.purpose: Actual variants/SKUs, not every theoretical combination

recommended_database_entities.name: retailer_listings
recommended_database_entities.purpose: Retailer-specific listing, URL, price, availability, seller

recommended_database_entities.name: synonyms
recommended_database_entities.purpose: Search synonyms, alternate names, and query expansion
